rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-") or (http.request.uri.path contains "xmlrpc.php") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.env")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.git")) or (http.request.uri.path contains "phpmyadmin") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/cgi-bin") or (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".php")) or (http.request.uri.path contains "/vendor/phpunit")

rules.description: Block empty and attack-tool user agents
rules.expression: (http.user_agent eq "") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "sqlmap") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "nikto") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "masscan") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "zgrab") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "nuclei") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "acunetix") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "wpscan")
